ios.desc:
Built on science, Sleep Cycle uses sound analysis to track and improve sleep for over 3 million users worldwide. Our AI sleep coach, sleep tracker and Smart Alarm clock app help users to identify potential sleep issues, gain valuable insights into their sleep patterns and build a healthier sleep routine.

Sleep Cycle is the world’s no.1 sleep app with more than 40 million downloads. Track your rest, wake refreshed, and build lifelong sleep habits.

AWARDS & RECOGNITIONS
Sleep Cycle has been awarded Best Sleep App in 2024 by Digital Health Magazine and featured as App of the Month in Wellness Today. In 2024, Sleep Cycle won two Merit Healthcare Awards: Gold for Mobile Digital Health Resources and Silver for Best Use of Artificial Intelligence.

WITH SLEEP CYCLE YOU CAN
• Get guidance based on your sleep patterns with our AI sleep coach Luma. 
• Wake up gently during your lightest sleep phase with our Smart Alarm clock.
• Track every night using patented sound technology or accelerometer-based sleep detection, no wearables needed.
• Detect nighttime noises like snoring, coughing, or sleep talking, for a path to quieter sleep.
• Drift off easily using our sleep sounds library of relaxing stories, sleepy soundscapes and guided meditations.
• Understand your sleep patterns with long-term trends and compare your sleep to global benchmarks.
• Log sleep notes to understand how caffeine, stress, or exercise affect your rest.

WHY USE SLEEP CYCLE?
• Wake feeling refreshed with no more groggy mornings.
• Get daily stats to help you understand your rest.
• Sleep guidance based on your tracked nights.
• Health insights with snoring and cough tracking for wellness.
• No gadgets, just place your phone on the nightstand.
• Premium tools like supportive soundscapes, sleep stories, data export, Philips HUE sunrise and Apple Health sync.

ABOUT SLEEP CYCLE
Sleep Cycle helps you sleep smarter. Track your nights, gain valuable insights into your sleep patterns, and wake at just the right time to start the day energized. Sleep Cycle gives you science-backed tools and an AI sleep coach Luma to help you improve your sleep for brighter days.

Our popular features include:
• Superior sleep tracker.

• Smart Alarm clock.
• Sleep talking recorder.

• Snore tracker.

quotes.text:
While I agree that the wake-up feature you described is not available from Apple directly, I bet there's a 3rd party app out there that does what you're asking.

I use the Apple alarm now and when if I go to sleep with my watch on, it will gently buzz on my wrist and get more forceful until I turn it off. The sensors to track sleep are all on the device, but Apple doesn't seem to have any interest in building a "sleep cycle" tracker at this time for whatever reason.

A cursory search turns up the "Sleep Cycle" app[0] with a ton of reviews and even an "Editors Choice" award. Maybe Apple is holding their horses until they 100% nail the implementation, but if you can live with 90% in the meantime, it would probably be worth it to you if this is a thing you're really wanting in your morning routine.

[0] - https://apps.apple.com/us/app/sleep-cycle-sleep-tracker/id320606217
